name: PancakeV3SwapHelper unwraps the swap's input delta as the WBNB output
summary: The unverified Pancake V3 swap helper 0x222c8580 takes the positive input delta of a USDT-to-WBNB swap as the WBNB amount to unwrap and pay out, so a swap of 1.651 USDT that returned 0.002 WBNB paid the caller 1.651 BNB from the helper's own WBNB inventory.
notes: The helper is immutable and has no storage writes after deployment that the exploit needed. Its 38 earlier calls, mostly in its first weeks, swapped for their callers without paying out more than the pool returned; the only later call (0x2c79dade) moved dust.
